title: WiFi Scanner & Network Tools
short_description: See who is on your WiFi. Ping, traceroute, DNS lookup and port checks.

guides.title: Common Network Ports List and What They Mean
guides.description: A list of common TCP ports on home networks, what each service does, and how to check which ports a device has open on your own network.

guides.title: WiFi Channel and Frequency Chart (2.4, 5, 6 GHz)
guides.description: Convert a WiFi frequency in MHz to its channel number, with a chart for 2.4, 5 and 6 GHz and how to pick a channel.

guides.title: WiFi Signal Strength Chart (dBm to Signal Quality)
guides.description: What WiFi dBm values mean, from -30 to -100 dBm. A chart, a quick lookup tool and what to do when your signal is weak.
